IS 3062 : 2024 Crop Protection Equipment - Rocker Sprayer - Specification and Test Code
ICS 65.060.40
ICS 65.060.40
FAD 11
FAD 11
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies material, performance, constructional and other requirements of rocker sprayer (rocker type mechanical device) used for spraying pesticides.
The sprayers of this type are normally used with an average working pressure of 600 kPa (100 kPa = 1.019 7 kgf/cm2 = 1 bar).
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
